note: Terms module-06 introduces, and the build that teaches each. Enforced by scripts/lint-glossary.mjs. Keep ASCII-only.

terms.gloss: The normalized value that says two records are the same account - here, the email in lower case with no stray spaces.
The one trusted record per real account, keyed by match key, that everything downstream reads.
The field-by-field rule for a merge: which copy's value wins. A value beats a blank; the golden id survives.
How sure the rules are that two records are the same, 0-100. At or above the threshold the rules merge; below it a person decides.
Adding facts a vendor knows (company size, industry) to a record you own. Bought data, checked before it is used.
Points a lead earns for size, industry and reachability, and the cutoffs that make it hot, warm or cold. Config RevOps owns.
The sales team a region's leads belong to.
